sprite:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2D pixel-art protagonist four-direction idle sprite atlas for a cozy top-down cooking RPG.
Input images: image 1 annotated character concept is design reference only (ignore all handwritten text, arrows, and page layout); image 2 clean character concept is the PRIMARY identity/color/costume reference. These are the same original character. Draw a fresh pixel translation, not a pasted illustration.
Primary request: exactly FOUR complete full-body small sprites of this SAME female chef character, FRONT / BACK / LEFT / RIGHT, arranged in a precise 2x2 grid. Top-left FRONT facing viewer/down, top-right BACK facing away/up, bottom-left true LEFT profile facing screen-left, bottom-right true RIGHT profile facing screen-right. Only four sprites, one standing idle frame per direction.
Identity: lively fire-themed young adult chef; short shaggy shoulder-length flame hair with golden-yellow upper locks and vivid vermilion-red underside/tips, one small upright flame-shaped hair tuft; cream soft floppy chef cap tilted toward HER RIGHT (viewer-left in front view); amber-orange eyes; white shirt with pale pink shadow and red cuff trim; bright red necktie with two small gold bars; warm cream apron with white ruffle hem over a short charcoal skirt; brown waist belt and brown mid-calf boots. Brown knife pouch is on HER RIGHT hip; red-yellow flame applique is on HER LEFT front apron. Black round frying pan strapped across her back, handle diagonally down toward HER LEFT. Maintain these asymmetries consistently when rotating; left and right MUST NOT be copy-flipped. Apron ties / pan visible from rear. Hands relaxed at sides, cleaver safely in pouch, no arm held out sideways.
Style: authentic small SNES farming RPG pixel sprites, compact 2.5-head body, slight top-down overworld view, BIG coherent square pixel clusters, economical 24–32 color palette, readable at about 48x64 logical pixels per character. Hard stair-step dark warm outline, flat stepped 2–3-tone shading. Do not draw high-res anime with pixel noise. No anti-aliasing, no soft gradients or brushwork. All four have equal body height, consistent head size, same orthographic projection and lighting.
Composition: SQUARE canvas, preferably 1024x1024, four invisible equal 512x512 cells. Each full character centered horizontally in its cell, soles at the same relative baseline ~90% cell height, top of cap/tuft ~10% cell height. Ample transparent gutters, nothing crosses cell boundaries, no cropping of hats/hair/feet. Outer background 100% transparent alpha, including cell gaps.
Avoid: labels, letters, arrows, dividers, gridlines, frames, floor, cast shadows, colored background, checkerboard painted into image, UI, extra people, extra poses, extra limbs, smooth outlines, large props obscuring face.
portrait_initial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent HALF-BODY micro-pixel dialogue portrait for the LEFT portrait compartment of a cozy farming/cooking RPG conversation box, whose dialogue text is to its right.
Input images: image 1 annotated concept = reference only; ignore all handwriting, annotations and arrows. Image 2 clean concept = PRIMARY identity, expression and costume reference. Use this exact original chef character, not a generic chef.
Primary request: one beautifully polished waist-up portrait in delicate handcrafted micro-pixel art. Character in a gentle three-quarter pose toward SCREEN-RIGHT, gaze warmly toward the reader/right-hand text. A confident mischievous small smile with one tiny fang, amber golden eyes, faint rose cheeks; lively, approachable, youthful adult. Preserve her original face and fiery personality.
Identity invariants: short shaggy flame-red hair with golden-yellow crown/large highlight locks and vivid red lower locks/tips; a SINGLE small upright flame-shaped hair tuft; soft cream floppy chef cap on HER RIGHT (viewer-left); white collared long-sleeve shirt with pale pink folded shadows/red cuff details; bright red necktie with two small gold horizontal bars; warm buttercream apron; brown waist belt, HER RIGHT brown knife pouch; HER LEFT red/yellow flame applique; a dark round frying pan strapped behind her shoulder. Pose keeps both arms naturally within the portrait silhouette, one hand lightly near apron waist. No outstretched arm or raised cleaver. No new clothing, jewelry or invented accessories.
Style/medium: refined game dialogue pixel portrait, finer pixel scale than the overworld sprite; cozy 1990s farming RPG portrait sensibility and Japanese character appeal, original interpretation of provided design. Controlled crisp square pixel clusters, visibly stepped edges, intentional small dithering only in selected shaded areas, warm nuanced palette, dark burgundy/umber contour, 3–5 discrete tones per material. About 192x224 logical-pixel detail, clean nearest-neighbor enlarged presentation. NOT a blurry downsample, NOT vector line art, NOT a smooth anime painting with a pixel filter.
Composition: one centered figure on transparent background, nearly front-facing with mild screen-right turn. Entire cap and flame tuft visible with generous headroom; crop at low waist just below belt so the apron and pouch top/flame motif can be read, no thighs or full body. Head/eyes are prominent, body stays inside safe side margins, bottom is a clean half-body crop. Portrait canvas around 1024x1024. No decorative portrait border, no dialogue panel, no writing, no logos, no watermark, no scenery, no floor, no shadow, no painted checkerboard. Actual transparent alpha.
